Package bakerydms

Interface OrderRepository

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    MySqlOrderRepository
    public interface OrderRepository
    Describes what the program needs from its data storage: find, add, change and delete orders.

    This is the interface planned in the Module 5 implementation plan. It says what storage must do but not how, so OrderManager works with any storage without changing its business logic:

    • MySqlOrderRepository stores orders in a MySQL database (the real program).
    • InMemoryOrderRepository, in the test folder, keeps them in a list so the unit tests run without a MySQL server.
    Any method may throw DataAccessException if the storage cannot be reached. Its message explains the problem in plain English.
    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
